{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coast Line''' was a mass transit [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] that ran around the coast of [[Estalle Island]]. It was elevated, and connected with the cross-island [[Crosstown Line]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
